message: さっちんのラブラブ相談

name: Sacchin
message: 「You're late~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Sorry, sorry. Just had a little something」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Nana-chan, you were late because you were overthinking things, weren't you~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「*Gulp*」

name: Nanaka
message: 「W-Well, yeah. You know, uh, stuff for the Holy Night Festival and all」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Wrong~ It's about Synn-kun, isn't it~?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「G-Gulp! How do you know!? N-No, that's not it!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Even the reason we're talking in a place like this at night isn't really about the Holy Night Festival, right~?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I―It is about the Holy Night Festival! We have to decide on our booth―」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Synn-kun must be on cloud nine with so many girls popping up around him~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I-It's not like I care who Synn falls for」

name: Sacchin
message: 「No lying~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I'm not lying... not really...」

name: Sacchin
message: 「No good~ Nana-chan, you don't have enough sense of urgency~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「T-There's no urgency... There's no way Synn would be popular anyway」

name: Sacchin
message: 「I see~ So the guy Nana-chan likes is just a boring guy who can't even get popular~」

name: Sacchin
message: 「If that's fine with you, then whatever~ Still, if this turns into a battle between girls, you're at a pretty big disadvantage, you know~?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「N-Not that I intend to do anything like that. J-Just out of curiosity, what do you think puts me at a disadvantage, Sacchin?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「To be specific~ In the bust department, you lose to Ria-senpai~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ugh. B-But Synn doesn't care about chest size... probably」

name: Sacchin
message: 「In the smarts department, you lose to Misa-chan~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ugh. B-But if that mattered, he wouldn't be childhood friends with me... probably」

name: Sacchin
message: 「If he's into younger girls, you lose to Lolotte-chan and Sally-chan too」

name: Nanaka
message: 「B-But Synn doesn't have tastes like that! P-Probably」

name: Sacchin
message: 「And, in terms of maidenly charm, you lose to everyone」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What the heck is maidenly charm supposed to be!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「How should I put it. I'm not saying you don't have any, Nana-chan, yours is just hard to notice」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Do you understand the crisis you're in?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「B-But――」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I've got them beat in sheer volume of memories! No doubt about that!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Yeah, but if you put it like that, wives would almost never have their husbands stolen by mistresses, right?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Besides. You don't have any of those classic tropes like a childhood promise, do you. If I remember right」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I-I just can't remember it yet! Maybe!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「The moment you don't remember it, it's already no good」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Y-You think...... so......」

name: Sacchin
message: 「I do. You really need to step things up!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「――So, did you come up with an act?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「You dodged the subject」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I am not dodging anything!」
